en.name: Gherkins in vinegar
en.summary: These are the ordinary jar and the French cornichon: cucumbers pickled in vinegar and pasteurised, not fermented. Unopened they keep about 12 months in the cupboard from purchase. Once opened, refrigerate and use within about 1–2 months, keeping the gherkins under the vinegar.
en.pantry: An unopened jar keeps about 12 months from purchase — cool, dark, dry and out of the sun, because light bleaches the gherkins and softens them long before anything else goes wrong. Vinegar-pickled gherkins are a high-acid food, so a sealed jar is genuinely stable; the failure modes are softening and colour loss rather than safety, unless the seal has gone. Do not keep a jar with a domed lid, a broken seal or a leaking rim.
en.fridge: Once opened, keep the jar at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 1–2 months. Keep the gherkins below the surface of the vinegar and use a clean fork — a finger, or a fork that has been on a plate, is how the white surface film starts. Once they have gone soft and hollow they are past it, which usually happens well before the end of that window if the jar has been in and out of a warm kitchen. That 1–2 months is the more conservative of the two published lines for opened pickles.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for pickled gherkins and freezing ruins them: a cucumber is mostly water, and what thaws is limp, hollow and watery. They are already a preserve with months of life in the fridge, so there is nothing to gain. Buy the jar size you will finish instead, and use the vinegar from the bottom of an empty jar in a dressing.
spoilage: Gherkins gone soft, hollow or slippery rather than crisp
A white film or fuzzy mould on the surface of the vinegar
Vinegar turned cloudy, ropy or foul-smelling
A domed lid, or fizzing when the jar is opened
tips: Use a clean fork, never fingers, and push the rest back under the vinegar.
Keep the jar out of the light — bleached gherkins go soft.
Write the opening date on the lid.
Save the leftover vinegar for salad dressings and potato salad.

faq.q: How long do gherkins last once opened?
faq.a: About 1–2 months refrigerated at 4 °C or below, with the gherkins kept under the vinegar.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar of gherkins keep?
faq.a: About 12 months from purchase in a cool dark cupboard, provided the seal is intact.
No timeline exists and it wrecks them. They thaw limp, hollow and watery; the fridge already gives them months.

faq.q: Are vinegar gherkins the same as salt-brined ones?
faq.a: No. These are pickled in vinegar and pasteurised. Salt-brined gherkins are a live fermentation that needs skimming and keeps to a different timeline.

zh.name: 醋漬小黃瓜
zh.summary: 這裡指的是一般罐裝和法式 cornichon：用醋醃漬、經過巴氏殺菌的小黃瓜，而不是發酵品。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 12 個月。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 1～2 個月內用完，全程讓小黃瓜泡在醋液裡。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐子從購買日起算大約 12 個月——陰涼、避光、乾燥、不要曬到太陽，因為光會讓小黃瓜褪色、變軟，而且遠早於其他問題出現。醋漬小黃瓜是高酸性食品，密封的罐子確實很穩定；只要封口沒問題，會出事的是軟化和褪色，而不是安全。蓋子鼓起、封口破損或瓶口滲漏的罐子就不要留。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下，並在大約 1～2 個月內用完。讓小黃瓜保持在醋液面以下，並用乾淨的叉子——用手，或用剛從盤子上拿起的叉子，正是表面白膜的起點。一旦變軟、變中空就過了，而如果這罐常在溫暖的廚房進進出出，通常會比這個窗口的終點早很多。這裡的 1～2 個月是兩份已發表資料中較保守的那一個。
zh.freezer: 醋漬小黃瓜沒有冷凍期限，冷凍也會毀了它：小黃瓜幾乎都是水，解凍後只剩軟塌、中空、出水的殘骸。它本來就是可以在冰箱放上好幾個月的醃漬品，冷凍毫無好處。與其冷凍，不如買吃得完的罐子大小，空罐底剩下的醋還可以拿來調沙拉醬。
spoilage: 小黃瓜變軟、中空或滑手，不再爽脆
醋液表面出現白膜或毛狀的霉
醋液變濁、牽絲或有異味
蓋子鼓起，或開罐時冒氣
tips: 用乾淨的叉子、不要用手，取完把剩下的壓回醋液裡。
罐子避光存放——褪色的小黃瓜會變軟。
剩下的醋液留著調沙拉醬或拌馬鈴薯沙拉。

faq.q: 酸黃瓜開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 1～2 個月，並讓小黃瓜保持泡在醋液裡。

faq.q: 未開封的酸黃瓜可以放多久？
faq.a: 只要封口完好，陰涼避光的櫥櫃從購買日起算大約 12 個月。
沒有對應期限，而且會毀了它。解凍後軟塌中空又出水，冷藏本來就能放好幾個月。

faq.q: 醋漬和鹽漬發酵的酸黃瓜一樣嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。醋漬是用醋醃並殺菌；鹽漬發酵是活菌發酵，需要撈浮沫，保存期限也不同。
